title: Lovely Sweet Peruvian Beef Stew
description: A sweet and nostalgic Peruvian dish featuring tender beef in a rich and flavorful broth, made with unsalted beef stock and binchotan-charcoal for a unique smoky flavor
instructions: Heat the binchotan-charcoal pieces in a dry skillet over medium heat until they are smoking
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is softened and caramelized
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute
Add the beef brisket pieces to the skillet and cook until they are browned on all sides
Add the unsalted beef stock, tomato paste, brown sugar, and soy sauce to the skillet and bring to a boil
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 2 hours
Add the peeled and cubed potatoes to the stew and continue to simmer for another 30 minutes
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste
